name: @oge-ui/react-pivot
description: React pivot grid from the OGE UI suite: local rows or a remote pre-aggregated store, four drag & drop field areas, multi-level column headers, expand/collapse on both axes, sub and grand totals, percent-of and running-total display modes, header and measure context menus, value filters, a field chooser, two-axis virtual scrolling, state persistence and CSV/Excel export — running the same framework-free pivot engine and the same stylesheet as the Angular pivot package. Source-available commercial license (free for evaluation and development).
author: kaya2m
